title: Federal Reserve Board - Agencies issue FAQ document regarding collateralized debt obligations backed by trust preferred securities under final rules implementing the "Volcker rule"
主要内容: On December 19, 2013, three U.S. federal financial institution regulatory agencies—the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency—issued a Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) document to clarify guidance for banking entities regarding investments in 'Covered Funds' under the final rules implementing the Volcker Rule. The document addresses whether collateralized debt obligations (CDOs) backed by trust preferred securities (TruPS CDOs) qualify as Covered Funds. It clarifies that banks holding TruPS CDOs are not required to sell these holdings immediately but may use the conformance period, ending on July 21, 2015, to determine if they can be brought into compliance. The FAQs outline key legal considerations, including whether TruPS CDOs can be restructured to meet the final rules and whether a bank's investment constitutes an ownership interest. The final rules were approved on December 10, 2013.
